notes.title: All In One Summer Sports VR Ver 0.5.0 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366028/61dd428591614c8cdb122b87dc958cd09cfeed8d.png[/img]



Hello, dear players.

In this version, various improvements and bug fixes have been made.

Here are the main updates:

[b]1. Water Park Movement Improvement[/b]
   The character movement in Water Park mode has been improved to be more natural and intuitive.

[b]2. Fishing Matchmaking Bug Fix[/b]
   The matchmaking issues in the fishing mode have been fixed. Problems that some users encountered during the matchmaking process in the previous version have been resolved, providing a smoother multiplayer experience. You can now enjoy fishing tournaments with your friends without any matchmaking failures or disconnections.

[b]3. Clay Shooting Bug Fix[/b]
   The bug that caused the game to freeze when exiting immediately after starting the clay shooting mode has been resolved. Now, even if you exit the game early, you can restart it normally, and this issue will no longer cause any inconvenience.

notes.title: Notice: Good Tip for new users
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366028/d3471b1e2641622c41943e39bbdf920d12ba95e2.png[/img]

Frequent problems and good Tip to know


1. If the controller is not recognized, check if the default device of steam vr is openxr.(if using SteamVr)

2. If you don't want to hear the other person's voice 
If you reduce the microphone to zero, you can't hear the other person's voice. 

3. if you want to do it with a friend
Make a secret room and let your friend know the code

4. If it's a bug or a problem with the play
https://discord.gg/tNthvWWnPw
If you tell me on the Discord server, I can resolve it quickly.
